name: Davco Sanitized Glue Grout
paste:
DAVCO SANITIZED GLUE GROUT: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Davco Sanitized Glue Grout, July 2023, Version 01.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/5/davco-sanitized-gluegrout.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Davco Sanitized Glue Grout where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (July 2023, Version 01.01).
1.2 Product description. A ready to use, white, pre-mixed, flexible, thin bed, internal wall tile adhesive and grout.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Surfaces
1.4 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer - Most common substrates.
    - cement renders
    - rendered brickwork and blockwork
    - plasterboard
    - fibre-cement wall sheets.
1.5 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer - Tiles.
    - Ideal for thin bed fixing of most types of porous backed ceramic tiles.
1.6 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer - Areas.
    - Suitable for interior applications.
    - Domestic walls including bathrooms, kitchens and laundries
1.7 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.7.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Davco Sanitized Glue Grout
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: A PREMIXED READY TO USE WALL TILE ADHESIVE AND GROUT
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (July 2023, Version 01.01) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - AS3958.1: referred to in instructions or limitations. Where: Important Considerations (p.2).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - White in appearance
    - Pre-mixed and ready for use
    - Dual use - adhesive and a grout
    - Ideal for fixing popped / litted tiles
    - No wastage
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Appearance / Colour: White paste
    - Volatile organic compound (VOC) content: Low VOC - Specification for V2 IEQ-13, V1.1 IEQ-11
2.6 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 500gm Pail
    - Shelf life: 12 months from date of manufacture.
    - Storage conditions: Store off ground in cool conditions out of direct sunlight. Do not allow to freeze

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (July 2023, Version 01.01) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Surface preparation.
    - All surfaces must be installed according to manufacturer’s instructions and relevant Australian Standard(s) and be structurally sound, dry, clean and free from movement, oil, grease, wax, sealers, curing compounds, release agents and any other loose or contaminating material. Thoroughly clean old surfaces, or new surfaces that have been treated, prior to tiling
    - Deeply contaminated surfaces must be scabbled / abraded to a clean, sound surface. Expose at least 80% of the original substrate of painted surfaces
    - Surfaces should be prepared and primed as per the following:
    | Substrate | Specific requirement | Primer |
    | Rendered brick / blockwork - wood float finish | Cured minimum 7 days Sound (not drummy or | Davco PrimeX or Davco Ultraprime |
    | (rough) | cracked) |
    | Fibre-cement sheet, plasterboard | Correctly and firmly fixed | Davco PrimeX or Davco Ultraprime |
    | Previously painted surfaces | Sand back to expose 80% of original substrate | Davco PrimeX or Davco Ultraprime |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (July 2023, Version 01.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Consumption: 500ml tub of Davco Sanitized® Glue Grout covers approximately 0.5m2 (based on a 6mm notch trowel when used as an adhesive)
    - Adjustability Time: 20-30 minutes depending on climate and porosity of substrate and tile.
    - Applied Product Ready for Use: 24 hours; Dry time is to be used as a guide and will be influenced by climate, substrate and tile porosity.
4.3 Mixing. Davco Sanitized Glue Grout t is ready to use straight from pail. No mixing required.
4.4 Application - As an Adhesive. 1. Spread approximately 0.5m² at a time. Press firmly into position before the adhesive skins. Ensure that the tiles are well bedded and that no voids occur under the tiles. Refer to ‘directions’ table to the left for trowel sizing.
4.5 Application - As a Grout. 1. Using a rubber float or squeegee, work the grout paste deep into the joints, making sure the grout is not just sitting on top. 2. Remove excess grout from the surface of the tiles with the float or squeegee using a diagonal motion to avoid dislodging the embedded grout. 3. A primary clean-up should be done next by wiping over with a damp cloth or sponge.
    - Allow product to set before grouting
    - Allow product to set firmly before return to service
    Note: Setting time of adhesive is affected by site conditions, climate and could be faster or slower than specified.
4.6 Cleaning of tools.
    - Clean tools and equipment with water before the adhesive dries.
4.7 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Do not apply in temperatures above 35ºC or below 5ºC.
    - In cool and / or humid conditions, allow longer setting times.
    - Do not allow the adhesive to skin prior to laying the tiles. If the adhesive skins remove and dispose of it, then re-apply fresh adhesive.
    - Do not use in grout joints wider than 3mm or to bond two impervious surfaces together or in areas of water immersion such as shower floors, swimming pools, spas etc.
    - Do not use for grouting areas any larger than 0.5m² – for larger areas, use Davco Sanitized® Colorgrout, Davco Elite G10 Grout or Davco Slate & Quarry Grout.
    - Not suitable for use on concrete substrates due to the extended drying times. Used a Davco cement-based tile adhesive.
    - For other uses not mentioned in these instructions, please contact Sika Australia.
4.8 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Test product in an inconspicuous area first
    - It is essential to plan the area to be tiled, with inclusion of movement joints, in accordance with the Australian Standard AS3958.1 “Guide to the Installation of Ceramic Tiles.” Failure to do so may result in drummy or lifting tiles. Make sure normal building or surface movement is accommodated by installing movement joints as follows:
    - Select a trowel with an appropriate square-notch size for the size and type of tile, as per the following:
    | Tile size | Notched trowel size | Back buttering required |
    | Mosaic | 4mm | No |
    | 100x100mm | 6mm | No |
    | 200x200mm | 8mm | No |
    | 300x300mm | 10mm | No |
    | 400x400 | 12mm | Yes |
    – Over movement joints in the substrate
    – At a junction between different substrate materials – At fixtures interrupting the tile surface e.g. columns – At internal vertical corners
    – Around the perimeter of the tiling system
    – At a maximum of 4.5m centres, in a grid pattern
    – Movement joints should be kept free from dirt and adhesive droppings
    – All movement joints can be filled with a suitable Sika ® flexible sealant

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.7):
    - Do not apply in temperatures above 35ºC or below 5ºC.
5.3 Trials, test areas and compatibility checks stated by the manufacturer.
    - Test product in an inconspicuous area first
5.4 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.5 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Davco Sanitized Glue Grout, July 2023, Version 01.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/5/davco-sanitized-gluegrout.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Davco Sanitized Glue Grout, version 28/01/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/s/sds-davco-sanitizedgluegrout.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
